verses.en: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
verses.sm: Peniamina o Pela lana ulumatua, o lona lua o Asepelu, ma lona toatolu o Aara,

verses.en: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.sm: o lona toafa o Noaa, ma lona toalima o Rafa.

verses.en: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
verses.sm: O atalii nei o Pela; o Atara, ma Kira, ma Apiuta,

verses.en: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
verses.sm: o Apisua foi, ma Naamanu, ma Aoki,

verses.en: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
verses.sm: o Kira, ma Sufimo, ma Huramo.

verses.en: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
verses.sm: O atalii ia o Akuta; o i latou ia O matai sili i e na mau i Kipea, ua latou tāfea i latou i Manaka;

verses.en: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.
verses.sm: O Naamanu foi, ma Akia, ma Kira; ua ia faatàfeaina i latou; na fanaua foi e ia o Usa, ma Akiuta.

verses.en: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
verses.sm: Ua fanaua ni atalii o Saaraima i le nuu o Moapi, ina ua aaueseina i latou e ia. O Husema ma Paara, o ana aya ia.

verses.en: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
verses.sm: Na fanaua e ia ai ia Hotesa lana ava o lopapa, ma Sepea, ma Mesa,

verses.en: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.
verses.sm: ma Malekama, Io o leusa foi, ma Savia, ma Merema. O ona atalii ia, o matai sili.

verses.en: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.
verses.sm: Na fanaua e Husema, o Apitopa, ma Elipaalu.

verses.en: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:
verses.sm: O atalii o Elipaalu; o Eperu, ma Mesama, ma Semeri, o le na faia Ono, ma Loto, ma ona faoa aai;

verses.en: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
verses.sm: O Peria foi, ma Sema, O matai sili ia i e na nonofo i Ailona, o e na tulia i latou sa nonofo i Kata;

verses.en: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
verses.sm: 0 Aio, o Sasaka, ma leremota,

verses.en: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,
verses.sm: O Sepatia foi, ma Arata, ma Eteru,

verses.en: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
verses.sm: o Mekaeli foi, ma Isepa, ma loka, o atalii o Peria;

verses.en: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
verses.sm: o Sepatia foi, ma Mesulama, ma Hiseki, ma Kaveru,

verses.en: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
verses.sm: 0 Isemerai foi, ma Iselia, ma Iopapa, o atalii o Elipaalu;

verses.en: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
verses.sm: O lakima foi, ma Sekari, ma Sapati,

verses.en: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
verses.sm: 0 Elienai foi, ma Seletai, ma Elielu,

verses.en: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;
verses.sm: O Ataia, ma Peraia, ma Semerata, O atalii o Sema;

verses.en: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
verses.sm: O Isefana foi, ma Eperu, ma Elielu,

verses.en: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
verses.sm: O Apetonu foi, ma Sekeri, ma Hanana,

verses.en: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
verses.sm: O Hanania foi, ma Elama, ma Anetotia,

verses.en: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
verses.sm: o Ifetia, ma Penieli, o atalii o Sasaka;

verses.en: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
verses.sm: o Sameserai foi, ma Sekareia, ma Atalia,

verses.en: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
verses.sm: O Iaaresea foi, ma Elia, ma Sekari, o atalii o Ieroama.

verses.en: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.sm: O matai sili ia i O latou tupulaga, o matai sili ia, sa mau i latou Ierusalema.

verses.en: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name was Maachah:
verses.sm: Sa mau le tama o Kipeona i Kipeona; o le igoa o lana avá o Maaka.

verses.en: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
verses.sm: O lona atalii le ulumatua O Apetonu, ile ma Suro, ma Kiso, ma Paala, ma Natapu,

verses.en: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.
verses.sm: o Kitoru foi, ma Aio, ma Sakaria.

verses.en: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.
verses.sm: Ua fanaua e Mekelota o Sema. Ua latou mau foi faatasi ma o latou uso i Ierusalema, ua faafeagai ma o latou uso.

verses.en: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
verses.sm: Ua fanaua e Neru o Kiso, ua fanaua foi e Kiso o Saulo, ua fanaua foi e Saulo o Ionatana, ma Makisua, ma Apinatapa, ma Esepaala.

verses.en: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.
verses.sm: O le atalii o Ionatana o Meripaala; ua fanaua e Meripaala o Mika.

verses.en: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
verses.sm: O atalii o Mika, o Pitonu, ma Meleka, ma Tarea, ma Aasa.

verses.en: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
verses.sm: Ua fanaua e Aasa o leoata; ua fanaua foi e leoata o Alemetu, ma Asemau, ma Semeri; ua fanaua e Semeri o Mosa.

verses.en: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
verses.sm: Ua fanaua foi e Mosa o Pinea; o Rafa lona atalii, O Eliasa lona atalii, o Aselu lona atalii.

verses.en: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.sm: O atalii o Aselu e toaono, O latou igoa foi ia, o Aserikama, o Pokeru, ma Isamaeli, ma Searia, ma Opetaia, ma Hanana. O i latou uma ia o atalii 0 Aselu.

verses.en: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.sm: O atalii o Eseki o lona uso; O Ulama le ulumatua, o Iuso o lona toalua, o Elipelete o lona toatolu.

verses.en: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
verses.sm: O atalii o Ulama o tagata fitafita lava, o e fanafana i aufana, ua toatele O latou atalii, ma atalii o latou atalii, c toaselau ma le toalimagafulu.
